models.name: GPT Image 2.5 Flare
models.shortDescription: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 Flare: fast, high-quality text-to-image generation and editing for everyday content, from social posts to product shots and quick creative concepts.

models.name: Topaz Image Upscale
models.shortDescription: Topaz Image Upscale by Topaz Labs enlarges photos up to 6x with five specialized enhancement modes, subject detection, and face enhancement controls.

models.name: 851 Labs Background Remover
models.shortDescription: Cut out any subject in one click. Open-source InSPyReNet gives clean edges on hair, fur, and glass, output as a transparent PNG, white, green screen, or blurred background.

models.name: Photoroom Expand
models.shortDescription: Expand any image's background to a new canvas size with AI-generated fill. Original content stays intact, new areas blend seamlessly.

models.name: FLUX.1 Dev
models.shortDescription: FLUX.1 Dev by Black Forest Labs. High-quality text-to-image and image-to-image with strong prompt adherence, ControlNet, and a top base for LoRA fine-tuning.

models.name: FLUX.1 Schnell
models.shortDescription: FLUX.1 Schnell by Black Forest Labs. A fast, few-step text-to-image model delivering quality results in as few as 4 inference steps.

models.name: FLUX 2 (Dev)
models.shortDescription: FLUX 2 (Dev) by Black Forest Labs is an open-weight image model built for fine-tuning. Stack up to 6 LoRAs, add up to 5 reference images, and generate up to 2048x2048.

models.name: FLUX.2 Klein 9b
models.shortDescription: FLUX.2 Klein 9b by Black Forest Labs. Fast text-to-image and image editing with strong style coherence, multi-reference support, and LoRA compatibility.

models.name: Flux.2 [klein] 9B Base
models.shortDescription: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B Base by Black Forest Labs. Undistilled 9B foundation model for text-to-image and image-to-image, built for LoRA fine-tuning and high output diversity.

models.name: Flux.2 [klein] 4B
models.shortDescription: Flux.2 [klein] 4B by Black Forest Labs. A 4B-parameter model distilled for sub-second image generation and editing, with LoRA support.

models.name: Flux.2 [klein] 4B Base
models.shortDescription: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base by Black Forest Labs. Compact, undistilled 4B image model built for LoRA compatibility, fine-tuning, and precise prompt control.

models.name: Z-Image
models.shortDescription: Z-Image by Alibaba Tongyi is a 6B open-source model for photorealistic image generation with best-in-class bilingual text rendering in English and Chinese.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo
models.shortDescription: Z-Image Turbo by Tongyi-MAI is a distilled open-source image model built for near-instant generation with strong photorealism and accurate text rendering in images.

models.name: Qwen Edit 2511
models.shortDescription: Qwen Edit 2511 by Alibaba edits images from plain text instructions. Add, remove, or restyle elements, with up to 6 LoRA styles and multi-reference image support.

models.name: Flux Kontext
models.shortDescription: Flux Kontext by Black Forest Labs. Edit images with text instructions, preserving characters and style across local or global edits. Supports up to 10 reference images.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 🍌
models.shortDescription: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image by Google: fast image generation and editing with resolutions from 512 to 4K, adjustable thinking depth, and optional Search grounding.

models.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
models.shortDescription: Prompt in, finished art out: posters, packaging, and key art with flawless text, even non-Latin scripts. Generate and edit with up to 10 references at 3136px.

models.name: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
models.shortDescription: xAI's Grok Imagine Image 2.0: text-to-image and multi-reference editing at 2K. Ranked #2 for image gen/editing, with legible typography and aspect ratios up to 21:9 and 5:2.

models.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro Layerize
models.shortDescription: Seedream 5.0 Pro Layerize by ByteDance splits a finished image into up to 17 layers: a clean base plus transparent PNG cutouts, with the background rebuilt behind what it lifts.

models.name: P-Image Ideogram
models.shortDescription: Text-to-image with Ideogram-grade in-image text rendering, tuned by Pruna. Adjustable Thinking effort, 1K or 2K output, and eight aspect ratios for posters, logos, and packaging.

models.name: Ideogram 4.5
models.shortDescription: Generate posters, logos and packaging with accurate in-image text up to 2K, or edit an image with up to four references and an optional mask. Four quality tiers.

models.name: Qwen Image
models.shortDescription: Qwen Image by Alibaba is a text-to-image and image-to-image model with strong text rendering and broad artistic style support. Up to 2048x2048.

models.name: FLUX 1.1 (Pro)
models.shortDescription: FLUX 1.1 (Pro) by Black Forest Labs is a fast text-to-image model that tops prompt-adherence and aesthetics benchmarks, generating photorealistic images in seconds.

models.name: Seedance 2.5
models.shortDescription: ByteDance's multimodal video model: text-to-video, first/last frame, reference-to-video, editing and extension. 4 to 30 seconds, 480p to 1080p, with native audio.

models.name: Tripo 3.1
models.shortDescription: Tripo 3.1 by Tripo AI converts a single image into a textured, game-ready 3D asset with PBR materials, adjustable geometry density, and quad mesh output.

models.name: Google Lyria 3.5
models.shortDescription: Generate full songs with sung vocals and your own lyrics. Set the length in the prompt, script sections with timestamps, and add up to 10 reference images. MP3 output.

models.name: 3D Platformer Environments 2.0
models.shortDescription: A Flux 2 LoRA for 3D low-poly environments suited to platformers and adventure games, with geometric shapes, vibrant colors, and soft lighting.

models.name: Sleek 3D Characters
models.shortDescription: Flux.1 LoRA for polished, stylized 3D character art. Generates warriors, robots, and wizards with expressive faces and detailed outfits.

models.name: Scenario Flux Upscale
models.shortDescription: Upscale images 2x to 8x with FLUX. Choose between precise, balanced, or creative presets to preserve structure or add imaginative detail.

models.name: Recraft Crisp Upscale
models.shortDescription: Recraft Crisp Upscale by Recraft AI sharpens and enlarges images, recovering detail and removing compression artifacts for clean, web or print-ready results.

models.name: P-Image Upscale
models.shortDescription: P-Image Upscale by Pruna AI. Fast upscaling up to 8 MP via target megapixel or side-factor mode, with optional detail and realism enhancement.

models.name: Photoroom Background Removal
models.shortDescription: Photoroom Background Removal by Photoroom. Clean, precise subject cutouts from any photo, with optional shadow effects and HD mode for high-resolution images.

models.name: Pixelcut Video Background Removal
models.shortDescription: Pixelcut Video Background Removal by Pixelcut. Remove video backgrounds with flicker-free temporal consistency. No green screen needed.

models.name: Reframe
models.shortDescription: Reframe expands any image to a new aspect ratio or size, filling the added canvas with matching, coherent content generated from your original.

models.name: Neo3D Realism
models.shortDescription: A Flux.1 LoRA for 3D-style renders. Generates detailed figurines, props, game collectibles, and sculptures with realistic textures and lighting.

models.name: Stage Dressing
models.shortDescription: A Flux.1 LoRA for painterly fantasy environments: ancient ruins, stone arenas, and dramatic outdoor scenes with rich lighting and vibrant colors.

models.name: Action Plastic 2.0
models.shortDescription: A Flux.1 LoRA that renders characters in dynamic poses with a collectible action figure aesthetic. Bold colors, exaggerated features, clean backgrounds.

models.name: Character Turnaround - Kontext
models.shortDescription: Generate a four-view character turnaround sheet from any character image, showing every side on a clean background.

models.name: Facial Expression Sheet - Kontext
models.shortDescription: Turns a character image into a 9-emotion expression sheet, preserving their look and art style.

models.name: Cartoon Costume Sets 2.0
models.shortDescription: Flux.2 LoRA for stylized 3D costume sets. Renders outfit collections and equipment on invisible figures with detailed textures and studio lighting.

models.name: Gem Icons v2
models.shortDescription: Flux.2 LoRA for stylized game icons: gemstones, crystals, and enchanted loot rendered with vibrant colors and polished digital painting.

models.name: RPG Environment
models.shortDescription: RPG Environment by Scenario. A Flux.1 LoRA for cohesive fantasy game assets: trees, ruins, props, and structures in a stylized top-down or side-scroller style.
